official_site_checks: Official public series pages expose Associated Name(s) and Related Series(s), which are retained in the Aidoku details description with relationship labels when present. Live /hot-updates cards expose chapter links and cover-host series ULIDs; /series/<ULID> resolves without a slug. Official public /search HTML exposes tri-state Official Translation, Anime Adaptation, and Adult Content controls. Regression tests verify each filter routes its Any/True/False state to the matching form field; Cloudflare challenge pages are rejected across search, details, chapter-list, reader and Home requests rather than accepted as empty results. Live official /search UI exposes all six sort modes, author text search, trivalent official/anime/adult filters, and 38 include/exclude tags; Aidoku DynamicFilters now exposes the supported UI and routes those values through the already-tested advanced-search fields. The visible Series Status and Series Type groups expose Ongoing/Complete/Hiatus/Canceled and Manga/Manhwa/Manhua/OEL. Selecting Complete and Manga in the live page produced included_status=Complete and included_type=Manga; the provider and request builder now expose these options. Official Advanced Search exposes the same 38 named tag checkboxes as the source filters; each serializes as included_tag or excluded_tag in the GET search form. Version 15 registers DynamicListings and exposes a paginated Popular listing per official tag, routing through /search/data with page-based offsets. Version 16 annotates each valid HTTPS reader image with its one-based display order and implements Aidoku PageDescriptionProvider; offline fixtures verify order, labels and malformed-URL filtering.
